question.text: A fund with a TVPI of 1.0x has:

answer.text: Returned exactly the invested capital — no profit and no loss

explanation.text: The Logic: TVPI is total value to paid-in capital. The workbook supports investment-multiple due-diligence comparisons above and below 1.0x, so a TVPI of 1.0x means total value equals paid-in capital — a break-even outcome in absolute terms. The Trap: Option B captures the break-even interpretation. Multiples above 1.0x represent gains; below 1.0x represent losses. Note: The earlier explanation added a fixed-deposit comparison, "failed investment" framing, a top-quartile 2.0x+ target, and a below-1.5x mature-fund underperformance benchmark. None of those are directly supported by the checked workbook and have been removed.
